de33_tests.topic: Two tests (Urbit, DOGE) and Book VI closing: checks on the executive — Guard ruling and withdrawal, the 2025 rescissions act

claims.text: Trump v. Illinois, 23 Dec 2025: in an unsigned order at a preliminary stage the Supreme Court refused to let the administration deploy National Guard troops in the Chicago area; the government 'failed to identify a source of authority that would allow the military to execute the laws in Illinois'; Alito, Thomas and Gorsuch dissented; Kavanaugh concurred in part; interim, not a merits ruling

31 Dec 2025: Trump said he was removing Guard troops from Chicago, Los Angeles and Portland for now: 'We will come back, perhaps in a much different and stronger form, when crime begins to soar again'; troops had left LA, and those sent to Chicago and Portland never reached the streets because of legal challenges; AP calls the Supreme Court order temporary

24 Jul 2025: Trump signed a bill cancelling about $9bn of previously approved spending, the bulk foreign assistance and about $1.1bn for the Corporation for Public Broadcasting; AP: programmes 'targeted by the White House's Department of Government Efficiency'
